import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0].strip())
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    nums = list(map(int, data[1].split()))
    total_ones = sum(bin(x).count('1') for x in nums)
    avg = total_ones / n
    print(round(avg))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
